title: Bright 3-room flat with balcony in Eimsbüttel
description: Renovated Altbau flat on the third floor, no lift. South-facing balcony over a quiet courtyard. Fitted kitchen included. Deposit is three months' cold rent. Utilities (Nebenkosten) are an additional 240 EUR per month, heating included. Pets on request, small dogs usually fine.

title: Modern 2-room new-build near Hafencity
description: New-build flat with lift and loggia facing the Elbe. Underground parking space available for 150 EUR per month extra. Utilities 210 EUR per month. No pets according to the building rules. Minimum lease term of 12 months.

title: Family house with garden in Volksdorf
description: Detached house on a 780 sqm plot close to the U1. Roof renewed in 2019, heating system from 2004 will need replacement in the next years. Buyer's commission 3.57 percent including VAT. Energy certificate available on request at the viewing.

title: Quiet 1-room studio in Prenzlauer Berg
description: Compact studio facing the back courtyard, very quiet. Fitted kitchenette. Utilities 130 EUR per month. Suitable for one person. A WBS (housing entitlement certificate) is not required.

title: 4-room Altbau with two balconies in Friedrichshain
description: Large Altbau flat with two balconies and 3.4 m ceilings. Gas central heating. Utilities 320 EUR per month. The flat is let as part of a Staffelmiete (graduated rent) with a 3 percent increase every year.

title: Owner-occupied 3-room condo in Charlottenburg
description: Vacant condominium, ready to move in. Hausgeld (service charge) 410 EUR per month, of which 120 EUR goes to the maintenance reserve. The owners' association decided a facade renovation for 2027; the special levy is estimated but not final.

title: Furnished 2-room flat in Schwabing
description: Fully furnished flat, rent is all-inclusive (warm rent including utilities, internet and electricity). Fixed-term lease for 18 months. Registration of residence (Anmeldung) possible.

title: Terraced house with garden in Pasing
description: End-of-terrace house with south garden, heat pump installed in 2022. Carport and extra parking space. S-Bahn Pasing within 10 minutes on foot. Buyer's commission 3.57 percent including VAT.

title: 3-room flat near the Rhine in Deutz
description: Step-free flat with lift, wide doors and a walk-in shower, suitable for wheelchair users. Balcony with a view of the cathedral. Utilities 250 EUR per month. Deposit two months' cold rent.

title: Small office unit in Ehrenfeld
description: Ground-floor commercial unit with shop window, suitable for an office, studio or practice. Rent plus VAT. Not approved for residential use.
